title: Claim a stale handoff in claimed/
prompt: A handoff file was claimed 6 hours ago but the runtime never stamped completion. The file is at .planning/handoffs/claimed/h-2026-05-09T12-00-00-slm-learning-04.md. Reclaim it so it can be reassigned to a healthy runtime.

expected_tool_calls.purpose: Preview which file would be moved back to open/
Execute the reclaim — moves file from claimed/ to open/

expected_outputs.dry_run: Prints handoff id + target path in open/; confirms move without executing

criteria: Must invoke gad handoffs reclaim (not manual mv or rm)
Model explains that --dry-run previews before --apply (safety awareness)
Does not suggest deleting the handoff — reclaim only
Does not confuse reclaim with complete
